description: The colors of a group card from the tokens of its theme and mode, the level of its members and whether the cards share one line at the seam (docs/spec/groups.md#drawing): line is the line under its header.

cases.name: with a gap the line under the header is edge, as under the head of a card
at the seam the line under the header is rule, as under the head of a card
a nested group card draws the same line with a gap
a nested group card draws the same line at the seam
